shared_elements: human figure(s) in low relief on stone
justification: A is a narrative frieze of many small figures in profile — archers, horses, a chariot, bows and arrows — arranged in a continuous horizontal band, while B is a single massive frontal human head-and-torso figure whose surface carries a few isolated incised motifs including a ring or disc and curved bands. Beyond the bare facts that both are relief-carved and both show human form and some circular motif, there is no shared subject, no shared relationship between elements, and no shared arrangement: one is a crowded profile action scene, the other a solitary frontal monumental figure.
